about_the_game:
An immersive sim set in an absurdly dystopian and nihilistic world. Eliminate your targets in fast-paced, ultra-violent fashion. Talk to lunatics, and explore surreal environments with psychedelic visuals and mind-bending soundscapes.

  • Around 8 hours of gameplay including side content — or 5 hours if you stick to the main story.

  • Tackle objectives your way with multiple paths and creative solutions.

  • Use a dozen unique weapons.

  • Buy upgrades and experiment to serve your own playstyle.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is ultra-violent and gory. You will witness a lot of blood and mass murder.
The world it’s set in is deeply deranged and nihilistic.
I advise against playing it if you're sensitive to such content.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 950 / AMD Radeon R7 370 or equivalent (2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
